generations.name: Second-generation GranTurismo
generations.notes: 92.5 kWh, 800 V pack, up to 270 kW DC, 22 kW AC (Type 2 in Europe). US production from MY2024. The 2026 facelift (MY2027) keeps the same pack, so it is not a new charging generation. EPA MY2024-2026; no NRCan row. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maserati_GranTurismo
